tenderAddress.blockNumber: Estate office, Krishi Nagar, UAS, Dharwad

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per tender documents annexed
University reserve the right to cancel the tender at time without assigning any reasons thereto.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A Minimum of 2 previous work orders and satisfactory completion letters issued by concerned authorities of UGC/AICTE/ICAR/NMC recognized universities/colleges are required, while the exemption as per MSME valid and can be claimed with proper documents.List of workdone Past supply for last 3 financial years with details of supply in Section- XII of the K/G-I documents along with supply orders & satisfactory completion certificates shall be provided by the bidders

Annual turnover certificate issued by CA for last 3 financial years-2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 shall be provided. The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be minimum Rs. 10 Lakhs during the last 3 preceding financial years. It shall be 50percent for MSMES during last 2 preceding financial years.

Declaration by the Publisher or authorized supplier on his letter head Indicating the fact that they are not black listed by any Government / Quasi Government Organizations / Institutions/ Universities
Declaration for abiding terms and conditions of tender and also declaration for abiding terms and conditions laid under the Goods Manual under standards tender documents- K/G-I.
Firm Registration Certificate / Membership certificate of FPBAI Federation of Publishers and Booksellers Association in India
PAN Card issued by I.T Department
Profile of the bidder along with Valid Address, Email. ID, Contact Person, Contact No., for correspondence and placing the supply order.
Technical bid- The bidders have to upload the list of e-books to be supplied with title and author of e-book
The agencies shall submit the signed documents of all sections of K/G-I standard tender documents uploaded by the purchaser in e-procurement portal
The publisher or its authorized agents / suppliers can participate in this bid/tender which should be supported by a letter of authorization.
The tenderer should have submitted IT returns for the Last 3 years- 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
